_comment: Routing norms and health-guard defaults for gyeol.coach. Policy data, not code. Every value is provisional until replaced by app-population norms (M8) and reviewed by a voice teacher / speech-language pathologist. These are NOT the item-display thresholds: those are always fitted (gyeol.coach.thresholds).

onboarding._poor_production_source: Pfordresher & Brown (2007): inaccurate ('poor-pitch') singers deviate by more than one semitone on average
onboarding._imprecise_source: provisional: half a semitone of trial-to-trial spread
onboarding._perception_source: provisional: typical adult pitch-discrimination thresholds lie well below a quarter tone; congenital amusia is associated with thresholds near or above a semitone (Peretz et al. 2002)

health._phonation_source: app default (accumulated voiced time, not session length); set with an SLP
